g.text: The 5 fundamental physical layouts defining how nodes communicate, cable count, fault domains, and scalability.
• Weakness: Single break drops whole segment
• Isolation: Node cable cut affects only that node
• SPOF: Central switch failure brings down all
✓ Pros: Zero single point of failure
Partial Mesh Alternative: Critical nodes are multi-homed, edge nodes have 2 redundant links.
Balances high availability with realistic port counts and transoceanic fiber expenditures.
• Structure: Combines Star + Bus into hierarchical tiers (Cisco 3-Tier Enterprise Model)
• Scalability: Easy expansion; adding a new department branch does not disrupt existing branches
• Risk: Root switch or distribution trunk failure segments sub-branches (mitigated via STP / LACP)
